<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 700" width="100%" height="100%">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <defs>
    <!-- Pattern for concentrated sucrose solution (dots) -->
    <pattern id="dots" x="0" y="0" width="12" height="12" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="1.8" fill="#555555" />
    </pattern>
    <!-- Arrow marker -->
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="5" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#000000" />
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ==================== APPARATUS ==================== -->

  <!-- Beaker -->
  <path d="M 220 280 L 220 540 C 220 555 230 565 245 565 L 455 565 C 470 565 480 555 480 540 L 480 280" 
        fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <!-- Beaker lip left -->
  <path d="M 210 280 L 230 280" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" />
  <!-- Beaker lip right -->
  <path d="M 470 280 L 490 280" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" />

  <!-- Distilled Water Level -->
  <path d="M 222 340 L 478 340" fill="none" stroke="#a0c0e0" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 3" />
  <text x="235" y="332" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#333333">Distilled water</text>

  <!-- Clamp / Stand holding the capillary tube -->
  <rect x="310" y="80" width="80" height="20" rx="3" fill="#dddddd" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
  <path d="M 335 100 L 335 140 L 365 140 L 365 100" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Capillary Tube (Outer walls) -->
  <path d="M 338 120 L 338 430" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />
  <path d="M 362 120 L 362 430" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />
  <!-- Capillary tube top & bottom open ends -->
  <line x1="338" y1="120" x2="362" y2="120" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Liquid inside capillary tube (Concentrated sucrose solution column) -->
  <rect x="340" y="180" width="22" height="250" fill="url(#dots)" />
  <!-- Meniscus at top of liquid column -->
  <path d="M 340 180 Q 351 174 362 180" fill="url(#dots)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Visking Tubing Bag -->
  <!-- Outer contour filled with dots and outlined -->
  <path d="M 338 430 C 338 430 290 450 290 490 C 290 530 310 545 350 545 C 390 545 410 530 410 490 C 410 450 362 430 362 430 Z" 
        fill="url(#dots)" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />

  <!-- Thread tied around the neck -->
  <path d="M 334 430 C 340 435 360 435 366 430 C 360 425 340 425 334 430 Z" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
  <path d="M 330 427 C 335 432 365 432 370 427" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Start level dashed mark on capillary tube -->
  <line x1="332" y1="360" x2="368" y2="360" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2" />

  <!-- ==================== LABELS AND POINTERS ==================== -->

  <!-- 1. Capillary tube -->
  <line x1="362" y1="230" x2="450" y2="230" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" />
  <text x="458" y="235" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15">Capillary tube</text>

  <!-- 2. Liquid level after 30 min -->
  <line x1="362" y1="180" x2="520" y2="140" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" />
  <text x="528" y="145" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15">Liquid level after 30 min</text>

  <!-- 3. Liquid level at start -->
  <line x1="368" y1="360" x2="520" y2="300" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" />
  <text x="528" y="305" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15">Liquid level at start</text>

  <!-- 4. Thread -->
  <path d="M 370 427 C 420 420 460 390 520 375" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" />
  <polygon points="520,375 511,372 514,380" fill="#000000" />
  <!-- To avoid clutter, let's use a cleaner horizontal leader for Thread -->
  <!-- Let's redraw Thread leader neatly -->
  <line x1="370" y1="428" x2="450" y2="390" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" />
  <text x="458" y="395" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15">Thread</text>

  <!-- 5. Visking tubing -->
  <path d="M 295 490 L 170 490" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" />
  <text x="55" y="495" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15">Visking tubing</text>

  <!-- 6. Concentrated sucrose solution -->
  <path d="M 320 515 L 170 550" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" />
  <text x="5" y="555" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15">Concentrated sucrose solution</text>

  <!-- 7. Distilled water -->
  <path d="M 478 340 L 530 340" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" />
  <!-- Already labeled above as text inside beaker, but let's add a clear pointer to the water volume if needed, or keep the text inside -->

  <!-- ==================== CAPTION ==================== -->
  <text x="350" y="630" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 2.1</text>

</svg>
